items: Toolbox Storage Case with Drawer The newly designed 1-drawer storage toolbox features a sliding-out mechanism and offers significantly more capacity than standard toolboxes. Equipped with a full set of commonly used hand tools, this sturdy toolbox with its complete tool accessories meets users' daily needs

High Quality Material This mechanics tool set all product accessories are crafted from premium steel through forging, undergo heat treatment for hardening, and feature surface rustproofing to withstand high-intensity and prolonged operational maintenance. Tools are neatly organized within a sturdy plastic toolbox for easy access and portability

Home Tool Kit For All Purpose 328-Piece Tool Set, ideal for homeowners' daily maintenance, organization, and DIY projects, including but not limited to homes, apartments, garages, workshops, trucks, cars, and mechanic shops; a highly versatile and comprehensive tool kit

Comprehensive 328-Piece Tool Set This comprehensive home tool kit includes a wide range of versatile manual tools such as screwdrivers, precision screwdriver bits, wire cutters, pipe wrenches, claw hammers, adjustable wrenches, hex keys, spirit levels, 40-piece bit sets, and full sets of 1/4“ and 3/8” sockets. Suitable for most household repairs, it's the ideal choice for craftsmen, mechanics, and homeowners

AS A GREAT GIFT This 328-piece tool set offers comprehensive coverage, exceptional value for money, and outstanding practicality, delivering remarkable value. It makes the perfect gift for men, fathers, boyfriends, or friends—whether for birthdays, Father's Day, Christmas, housewarming celebrations, or personal use—serving as the ideal foundational household tool kit
